motion.name: ease-paper
motion.purpose: Default exponential ease-out for settling sheets, rising folders, stack reorder, bars, and the file view transition.

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.value: 520ms ease-paper, 45ms stagger; from opacity 0, translateY(10px), blur(2px)
motion.purpose: Content entering a sheet or tab panel.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: 420ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1), 260ms delay; scale 1.35 to 0.97 to 1 at the stamp tilt

motion.name: pen-stroke
motion.purpose: Pen ticks and loops being drawn.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.value: 700ms ease-paper, 12ms stagger + 120ms; scaleY from 0 at bottom

motion.name: file-pull
motion.value: view transition 460ms ease-paper with mid-flight 2px blur
motion.purpose: Shared monogram and name when a file is pulled from the desk.

motion.name: sheet-swap
motion.value: out 180ms ease-in to translateY(-6px); in 420ms ease-paper +60ms from translateY(12px)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and view transitions removed under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Content is visible by default; motion only adds.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes persistent; sheet scrolls internally.

narrative.overview: A deep forest pressboard frames the workspace and one cool, bright sheet of paper stock carries all reading. Each child is a folder: the desk stacks those that need the therapist, and opening one lifts it into the full file whose index tabs flip sections. Dense and honest rather than decorative: tabular mono numerals, an event barcode per child, rubber-stamped dates, and ballpoint pen marks for the therapist's review. Gold is rationed to mean 'this needs you'. Trilingual, with he and ar mirrored.
keyCharacteristics: Pressboard frame, sheet-stock reading surface, faint fibre texture
Index-tab inks with gold reserved for therapist action
Tabular mono figures and tilted rubber stamps
Pen tick and pen loop as review language
Paper-weight motion: exponential ease-out, no bounce

rules.name: The Gold Means You Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where the therapist must act. Primary actions are forest pressboard ink.

rules.name: The Wash-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: A tab tone appears as wash with its matching ink text, or as a solid dot or bar.

rules.name: The Ruby Is Intensity Rule
rules.body: Ruby marks high intensity and skipped steps, not generic chrome errors.

rules.name: The Grid-Locked Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every count, time, and duration is tabular Geist Mono.

rules.name: The Script Swap Rule
rules.body: In he and ar, display switches to Heebo or Cairo 800.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: All reading happens on the single sheet laid on the board; no floating tile grids.

rules.name: The Paper Weight Rule
rules.body: Shadows fall downward, soft, with an inset white top edge; no glows or hard offsets.

rules.name: The Tab Joins the Sheet Rule
rules.body: An active index tab shares its surface with the sheet or panel below.

dos: Do use forest pressboard ink for the primary action on any sheet.
Do reserve gold for items needing the therapist's action, pairing gold wash with gold-ink text.
Do set every number and time in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do stamp dates in stamp slate and mark review only with pen ticks and pen loops.
Do draw new icons as 24px duotone glyphs matching the set.
Do verify every surface in he and ar.
donts: Don't use gold for primary buttons, decoration, or emphasis that asks nothing of the therapist.
Don't use cream or warm paper for the sheet.
Don't break reading content into floating white KPI tiles.
Don't import a generic icon library into product chrome.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing, or hide content until an animation runs.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels as section kickers; the mono stamp is only for dates, now, and the sample-data notice.
